prompt: The seed exchange keeps early and evening places on separate lists. A confirmation email proves the registration only for the time it names. Yun has an evening confirmation and an early-time request marked “waitlisted.” The desk can lend tools only after a time has been confirmed. Yun's email is therefore _____ for borrowing tools at the early session.
promptZh: 種子交換活動把早場與晚場分開登記。確認信只能證明信中時段已完成登記。允收到晚場確認信，而他的早場申請仍標示為「候補」。櫃檯須等時段確認後才能借出工具。因此，針對在早場借用工具，允的確認信_____。

options.whyZh: 晚場確認信不證明早場已登記成功，候補也不等於確認，因此無法據此在早場借工具。

options.text: sufficient if shown with the waitlist request
options.zh: 和候補申請一併出示就已足夠
options.whyZh: 早場候補申請仍不是早場確認；加上晚場確認信也不會取得早場資格。

options.text: valid proof of an early booking
options.zh: 是早場預約的有效證明
options.whyZh: 已確認的是晚場，不是早場。

options.text: a replacement for an early confirmation
options.whyZh: 活動時段分開登記，晚場信不能代替早場確認。

explanationZh: 晚場確認信不證明早場已登記成功，候補也不等於確認，因此無法據此在早場借工具。
evidence: A confirmation email proves the registration only for the time it names. / Yun has an evening confirmation and an early-time request marked “waitlisted.” / The desk can lend tools only after a time has been confirmed.

vocabulary.note: 報名狀態用語，表示仍在等候名額，可與 confirmed 對照。
